minutes.headline: Stormwater task force found errors in its draft fee spreadsheet and agreed to fix it and meet again Wednesday.
minutes.summary: The task force debriefed on its Select Board and Finance Committee presentations, then reviewed a member's spreadsheet of stormwater fees against current tax bills. Members found the fee column did not match the stated per-unit rate, agreed to drop the 10% cap column, simplify the sheet, and handle multi-unit properties as exceptions. They planned the public info session and town meeting presentations, and approved prior minutes and adjourned by roll call.

votes.motion: Approve the minutes of June 24th, August 12th, August 31st, September 8th, September 14th and September 21st, 2026

budget_items.what_was_said: The draft spreadsheet computes fees from a per-ERU rate and compares them with each property's current tax bill.
Members checking rows found the fee column did not match the stated rate; the sheet was built on an older run tied to the proposed budget.
If funded through the operating budget the stormwater line would have to rise, so tax bills would go up.

decisions.decision: Drop the 10% cap column from the spreadsheet and do not apply a cap.
Rename columns (current tax, utility fee, impervious area), add use-code key and ERU explanation, keep street, owner and address.
Put exceptions such as Carousel Lane on a separate tab.
Meet by Zoom Wednesday at 6 pm to sign off on the corrected spreadsheet, after it is circulated by BCC.
Put a formal task force vote on the warrant article on the next agenda.
Post the public info session as a meeting with a town meeting presentation review item.
Bill, John and Jenny to present at the public info session; Bill alone for town meeting.

what_happened.line: The Stormwater Task Force found that the fee column in its draft spreadsheet did not match the stated per-unit rate, and agreed to correct it.
Members agreed to drop the 10% cap column and not apply a cap.
Multi-unit properties such as Carousel Lane will go on a separate exceptions tab, and the columns will be renamed with a use-code key and ERU explanation.
The task force will meet by Zoom Wednesday at 6 pm to sign off on the corrected spreadsheet once it is circulated.
Presenters were chosen for the public info session and town meeting, and a formal task force vote on the warrant article goes on the next agenda.

why_it_matters: The spreadsheet compares a proposed stormwater fee with each property's current tax bill, so errors in it would change what owners are told they would pay.
If stormwater were funded through the operating budget instead of a separate utility fee, the budget line would have to rise and tax bills would go up.
